target.title: fix(ui): bound Nostr profile write/read requests
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `putNostrProfile` and `importNostrProfile` helpers in `ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.ts` issue `fetch` requests to the gateway/relay Nostr profile endpoint **without any timeout or abort signal**. A stalled or unreachable endpoint hangs the channels page indefinitely while it awaits the response.

This mirrors the same class of unbounded-network-operation fixes (e.g. `fix(ci)`, `fix(docker)`, `fix(doctor)` "bound X" PRs): an unterminated request with no `AbortSignal` can block the UI forever.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add an `AbortController` + `setTimeout` watchdog (`NOSTR_PROFILE_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000`) to both fetches, following the existing Control UI convention used by `browser-client.ts`, `custom-theme.ts`, and `agent-select.ts`. The timeout is cleared in `finally` so no timer leaks.

## User Impact

The channels Nostr profile publish/import actions now fail fast instead of hanging when the relay is slow or down.

## Evidence

### Real behavior proof

**Behavior or issue addressed:** Nostr profile publish/import (`putNostrProfile`, `importNostrProfile`) hang the channels page forever when the gateway/relay endpoint never responds, because the fetch has no abort signal.

**Real environment tested:** macOS 15, Node v24.18.0, vitest 4.1.10, local HTTP server (`node:http`) bound to 127.0.0.1:0. Real `fetch` is used against that server; only relative-URL resolution is bridged to the local origin.

**Exact command run:**
```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/channels/nostr-profile-ops.test.ts
```

**Terminal output after fix:**
```
 RUN  v4.1.10 /Users/maomaoplanet/projects/xydigit-zt-openclaw-worktrees/pr-110009

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  6 passed (6)
   Start at  19:43:05
   Duration  697ms (transform 54ms, setup 36ms, import 9ms, tests 29ms, environment 533ms)

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 1.05s
```

**Observed result after fix:** All 6 tests pass, including:
- Normal `putNostrProfile` round trip resolves correctly
- Normal `importNostrProfile` round trip resolves correctly  
- Stalled `putNostrProfile` aborts after 15s bound (using fake timers)
- Stalled `importNostrProfile` aborts after 15s bound (using fake timers)
- Edge cases with persisted flag handled correctly

**What was not tested:** A full live Control UI browser session against a real Nostr relay was not executed (no relay credentials / headless browser in this environment). The proof exercises the exact production fetch/timeout/abort code path against a real local server, which is the behavior the change governs.
